title: Zanzibar Weather by Month
excerpt: Zanzibar has a tropical climate, warm all year, with two rainy seasons. What to expect month by month.
body:
Zanzibar is warm all year, with daytime temperatures usually around 28–32 °C. The main question is rain.

## January–February

Hot, humid and mostly dry. A popular time.

## March

Getting hotter; the long rains may begin towards the end.

## April–May

The long rains. Heavy showers, high humidity. Some hotels close. See [Zanzibar in the rainy season](/blog/zanzibar-rainy-season/).

## June

Rain fades, pleasant temperatures.

## July–October

Dry, sunny and slightly cooler, with a breeze. High season.

## November

The short rains: usually short showers, often sunny in between.

## December

Mostly dry, busy around the holidays.

## Sea

The water is warm all year. Wind varies by season, which is important for [kitesurfing](/blog/kitesurfing-paje/).

See [Tanzania weather by month](/blog/tanzania-weather-by-month/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
